environment.description: Provider API exposed through an internal NLB with a TCP listener on port 8443. An Istio ingress gateway sidecar is injected into the provider pod with a PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mode on the namespace, requiring mutual TLS (mTLS) for all inbound connections. The Istio DestinationRule for the service specifies trafficPolicy.tls.mode=ISTIO_MUTUAL. Additionally, an AuthorizationPolicy restricts source principals to 'cluster.local/ns/terraform-runner/sa/terraform-sa' only. The NLB target group health check hits /health on port 8443 via the Envoy sidecar. Note: the application code itself does not implement TLS — all TLS handshake and client certificate validation is handled by the Envoy proxy sidecar before traffic is forwarded to localhost:8443.
